headline: Japan quake rescue ends at mall as death toll reaches 34
summary: Authorities ended the five-day search at a collapsed mall, while more than 9,000 people remained in shelters and water shortages affected the region.
script: Japan ended the five-day rescue operation at a collapsed mall after a magnitude seven point one quake killed thirty-four people. More than nine thousand survivors remained in shelters, while water shortages and extreme heat complicated recovery.
imageAlt: A damaged street and collapsed tiled roofs in Kumamoto after the earthquake.
